nodes.name: Telleroo webhook
nodes.notes: Rejects any call without the authenticity token header (credential 'Telleroo webhook token': header name and value as agreed with Telleroo).

nodes.name: Save event
nodes.notes: Every webhook is kept in telleroo_events; a repeat is saved once.

parameters.query:
select coalesce(
  $1::jsonb->>'pay_run_id',
  (select telleroo_id from public.telleroo_pay_runs
   where $1::jsonb->>'idempotent_key' is not null
     and payments @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('idempotentKey', $1::jsonb->>'idempotent_key'))
   order by updated_at desc limit 1)
) as pay_run_id;

nodes.name: Find pay run
nodes.notes: Pay run events name their pay run. Payment events only carry our idempotent key, so look up the pay run that holds that payment.

parameters.query:
select telleroo_id as pay_run_id
from public.telleroo_pay_runs
where status not in ('paid', 'cancelled')
  and last_checked_at < now() - interval '25 minutes'
order by last_checked_at
limit 50;

nodes.name: Open pay runs
nodes.notes: Catches anything a missed webhook would have told us.

nodes.name: Get pay run
nodes.notes: Read-only. Always re-reads the pay run rather than trusting the webhook.

parameters.query:
insert into public.telleroo_pay_runs
  (telleroo_id, idempotent_key, name, account_id, status, payees_type, payments_reason, scheduled_for,
   requested_amount, accepted_amount, paid_amount, due_amount, currency, payments, telleroo_url, telleroo_created_at, last_checked_at)
select telleroo_id, idempotent_key, name, account_id, status, payees_type, payments_reason, scheduled_for,
   requested_amount, accepted_amount, paid_amount, due_amount, currency, coalesce(payments, '[]'::jsonb), telleroo_url, telleroo_created_at, now()
from jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) as r(
  telleroo_id text, idempotent_key text, name text, account_id text, status text, payees_type text, payments_reason text,
  scheduled_for timestamptz, requested_amount numeric(12,2), accepted_amount numeric(12,2), paid_amount numeric(12,2),
  due_amount numeric(12,2), currency text, payments jsonb, telleroo_url text, telleroo_created_at timestamptz)
on conflict (telleroo_id) do update set
  idempotent_key = excluded.idempotent_key, name = excluded.name, account_id = excluded.account_id, status = excluded.status,
  payees_type = excluded.payees_type, payments_reason = excluded.payments_reason, scheduled_for = excluded.scheduled_for,
  requested_amount = excluded.requested_amount, accepted_amount = excluded.accepted_amount, paid_amount = excluded.paid_amount,
  due_amount = excluded.due_amount, currency = excluded.currency, payments = excluded.payments, telleroo_url = excluded.telleroo_url,
  telleroo_created_at = excluded.telleroo_created_at, last_checked_at = now(), updated_at = now();

parameters.content:
## Telleroo events (sandbox)
Saves Telleroo webhooks and pay run status in Supabase, so nothing is lost while the app is asleep. **Read-only:** it never creates, submits or approves pay runs.

**Webhook URL for Telleroo:** https://hinkleyhomes.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/telleroo-sandbox
Events: payment_sent, payment_failed, payment_cancelled, pay_run_awaiting_approval, pay_run_approved, pay_run_payments_sent

**Credentials**
- *Telleroo webhook token* (Header Auth): header name and token as agreed with Telleroo.
- *Telleroo (sandbox)* (OAuth2 API): Authorization Code; Authorization URL https://sandbox.app.telleroo.com/oauth ; Access Token URL https://sandbox.telleroo.com/oauth/token ; scope `create` ; Authentication: Send in body; client id and secret from Telleroo. Redirect URL is shown in the credential (https://hinkleyhomes.app.n8n.cloud/rest/oauth2-credential/callback).
- *Postgres (Telleroo)*: login n8n_telleroo_writer (lib/db/sql/n8n-telleroo-writer.sql).

**Production:** duplicate, set path `telleroo`, Variable TELLEROO_API_URL = https://api.telleroo.com, and a production OAuth credential (admin.telleroo.com/oauth, api.telleroo.com/oauth/token).
